opening.argument: The video presents an ordinary commercial use of a purported OneCoin payment card. The speaker says, “we're going to pay the dinner with One,” while the footage shows a woman holding a payment card or device at a restaurant table as another person presents a payment terminal. The speaker then characterizes the observed transaction by saying, “As you can see OneCoin works.” Although the presentation uses positive language about participation, it does not promise investment returns, describe earnings dependent on recruitment, or request credentials or other sensitive data. The evidence therefore supports a payment demonstration and product promotion, not an investment or data-harvesting solicitation.
